_comment: v1.11.1 - the first De Bello Gallico content batch: Book I (6) and Book II (4). All pages print bracketed chapter numbers [n] and nothing else, so spans are free and no marker `fix` is needed anywhere. Two excerpts deliberately stop short of the chapter's end (I.1 at section 4, I.53 at section 7) and one starts inside it (I.40 from section 10); the visible subsection numbers disclose that, so no [...] cut mark is used - nothing is cut out of the middle. Two excerpts span two chapters (II.20-21, II.27-28).
